Session at World AI Summit 2026

Dr Ravikumar Surpur, IAS is a confirmed speaker at World AI Summit 2026, 14-15 October 2026, Sheraton Grand Bangalore Hotel at Brigade Gateway, Bengaluru, India. Session title, time and hall will be published on this page once the agenda is final. See the agenda.

About Dr Ravikumar Surpur, IAS

Dr Ravikumar Surpur, IAS, is Secretary of the Information Technology and Communication Department and of the Planning and Statistics Department, Government of Rajasthan, and Chairman of RajComp Info Services Limited (RISL). The posting took effect on 24 November 2025. Surpur had held additional charge of the IT&C department since September 2025 while serving as Chairman of the Rajasthan State Pollution Control Board, and earlier in 2025 was Divisional Commissioner of Bikaner.

An officer of the 2004 batch of the Indian Administrative Service, Rajasthan cadre, Surpur has served as District Collector and District Magistrate of Jaisalmer, Hanumangarh, Sawai Madhopur, Bhilwara, Kota and Jodhpur, and as Commissioner of the Commercial Taxes Department (2022-2024) and Secretary, Finance (Revenue) (2024-2025). Other postings include Deputy Secretary in the Finance Department, Director of Elementary Education, Additional Mission Director of the National Rural Health Mission and Commissioner of the Rajasthan Housing Board. From 2019 to 2022 Surpur was on deputation to the Government of Karnataka.

Surpur holds an MBBS degree.

About Government of Rajasthan

The Department of Information Technology and Communication (DoIT&C), Government of Rajasthan, originated as the Department of Computers in 1987 and formulates and implements the state's IT policy and e-governance projects. RajComp Info Services Ltd (RISL), incorporated in 2010, is the wholly state-owned IT consultancy and designated agency for National e-Governance Plan projects in Rajasthan.
